reasons.platforms: bbpPairings' random tournament generator is not portable across standard libraries, so macOS and Linux build different tournaments from the same seed; each platform has its own baseline.
reasons.zelfde-paren-andere-kleur: Colour choice in round 2 after a player was absent in round 1; bbpPairings and JaVaFo disagree with each other in some of these cases.
reasons.andere-paren: Different pairing in the last round; under investigation (see the nightly artifact of the differences).
